title: Act: Subscribe BootScene to transitionTo with fade-out and scene start
summary: Add transitionTo subscription and handler in BootScene
description: In BootScene.ts add a private unsubscribeTransition field, subscribe in create after the playAnimation subscription, and add a handler that fades out then starts the scene.
acceptance_criteria: FADE_OUT_COMPLETE calls scene.start with the sceneId

steps.action: Add a private field unsubscribeTransition typed (() => void) | null initialised to null, next to unsubscribeAnimation.

Add private method transitionToScene(sceneId: string) that reads the durationMs of the first scene.effects entry with type 'transition' (default 400), calls this.cameras.main.fadeOut(durationMs), and registers this.cameras.main.once(Phaser.Cameras.Scene2D.Events.FADE_OUT_COMPLETE, () => this.scene.start(sceneId)).
steps.expected: Method compiles and is the only place that fades out.

steps.action: Subscribe to the transitionTo event and store the returned unsubscribe in this.unsubscribeTransition.
